task: Phase 2 task 009: milestone aria-live region for SegmentRenderMonitor (§7A dual-layer a11y)

frontend/src/components/progress/Segment.summary: Adds the previously-missing half of the §7A dual-layer accessibility contract: a visually-hidden ('sr-only', matching the repo's existing utility class) 'aria-live="polite"' 'role="status"' region that announces only milestones (render start, coarse count-based thresholds proportional to segment total — every 10 segments or 25%, whichever is coarser — and completion, with a failed-count variant) via new local state (announcement) + refs (startedRef/completedRef/lastThresholdRef) and an effect keyed on total/doneCount/allSettled/failedCount. Never fires per-segment/per-tick. The existing role="img" decorative block field, aria-hidden per-segment blocks, and SegmentAccessibleTable are unchanged. No prop/type contract change — fulfills an already-documented progress-presentation.md §7A requirement, so no spec_version bump.

flow_impact: SegmentRenderMonitor now emits assistive-tech milestone announcements (start/threshold/complete) alongside its existing visual strip and accessible table; no change to props, exported symbols, or the M1-M3 render/aggregate contract. No other file's flow is affected.
